text:
olivia: Quick sync — proposing a small 8-week "commitment pilot" cohort for design partners to test recruitment + feedback loop. Looking for alignment on recruitment criteria, incentives, signals, and launch gates. Please react with :thumbsup: or call out blockers.

sam: Love it. What's the target sample size?

olivia: Aim 6-10 partners, mix of PLG startups and mid-market product teams. Need at least 2 with dedicated/private infra use cases.

raja: I can surface 3 candidates from current leads. We should lock NDA + lightweight SOW up front.

maria: Agree on SOW. For incentives — propose a combo: credits, priority onboarding support, and product roadmap influence (early private-deploy access).

ben: How are we defining success? retention, integrations, qualitative signal?

olivia: Proposed success metrics: 1) >=75% active engagement by week 4; 2) at least 3 measurable integrations or embedding workloads across cohort; 3) ≥2 paid pilots committed within 3 months post-cohort; 4) zero severity-1 regressions tied to cohort releases.

sam: For feedback loops — weekly 30-min check-ins + shared async notes + short automated micro-survey after each release. We should also run a small eval prompt set to track quality delta.

olivia: Agreed. We'll automate metrics capture via Console traces and token-level cost reports. Screening + intake snippet:

```yaml
screening:
  company_stage: "seed_or_growth"
  primary_use_case: ["search", "assist", "chat"]
  data_sensitivity: "low|medium|high"
  commitment: "weekly_checkin:yes"
```

raja: Nice. Ops/timeline?

olivia: Recruit Apr 4–18, onboarding Apr 20–24, pilot May 1–Jun 26 (8 weeks). Launch gates: signed NDA+SOW, onboarding checklist completed, eval baseline collected, support oncall assigned.

eng-bot: deploy-bot: created channel #pilot-commitment-cohort and onboarding-checklist template.

maria: I can draft the SOW and the roadmap influence brief. I'll loop in Legal for NDA template.

ben: One ask — we need an explicit rollback/fallback plan and a list of lower-cost model variants for burst/fallback days.

olivia: Good call — will include canary + auto-fallback policy and a documented model-variant routing table.

sam: :thumbsup: from me. I'll prepare a candidate shortlist by EOD Friday.

raja: I'll outreach to the three I flagged and confirm commitment. +1 on incentives.

olivia: Thanks all. If no objections I'll ship the PR for the recruitment landing page and the intake form tomorrow morning. :rocket:

(quick note: keep messages short in this thread, we'll move tactical onboarding checklists to the new channel created by deploy-bot)
